rationale: After observing the initial label-swap relation error, test exact repetitions, joint localization, color referents, blank background and arithmetic on the actual predicted points.

conditions.name: swapped_photo_relation_repeat1
conditions.prompt: TARGET T: center of the colored dot labelled T. REFERENCE P: center of the colored dot labelled P. Use the dot centers, not the letter centers; compare only these annotated points. Compare TARGET relative to REFERENCE in the image plane. Output only vertical and horizontal relations.

conditions.name: numeric_from_swapped_predicted_points
conditions.prompt: Use only these numeric coordinates, no image or object identification: TARGET T={"x": 736, "y": 775}; REFERENCE P={"x": 657, "y": 317}; both use x increasing right and y increasing down. Compare TARGET relative to REFERENCE. Output only vertical and horizontal relations.

limits: Follow-up chosen after initial results; not an independent preregistered benchmark.
Repeated exact requests are not independent scenes or a population reliability estimate.
No correction or best-response selection; all first responses retained.
